content.introduction: Stephens co-CEO John Stephens discusses the state of the economy, M&A momentum, and the IPO pipeline on CNBC’s UP.Summit in Bentonville, AR. He shares insights on how the family-owned investment bank navigates deal flow, the outlook for interest rates and inflation, and the role of middle-market businesses in driving growth. Stephens also reflects on the firm’s Arkansas roots, ties to Walmart and Tyson Foods, and anticipates strong public and private markets in 2026 and beyond if economic policies improve.

Stephens co-CEO John Stephens joins CNBC’s Morgan Brennan at the UP.Summit in Bentonville, AR to discuss the state of the economy, M&A momentum, and the IPO pipeline. Stephens shares how the family-owned investment bank is navigating deal flow, the outlook for interest rates and inflation, and why middle-market businesses across America are driving growth.
